Pull the full registry\n$regPieces = @()\ntry {\n    $regResp = Invoke-RestMethod \"https://phoenix-architecti.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/api/art?limit=400\" -TimeoutSec 15\n    $regPieces = $regResp.pieces\n} catch { Write-Warning \"REGISTRY_SYNC: registry fetch failed — $($_.Exception.Message)\" }\n\n# 3. This makes the art registry a living cross-reference — searchable by run, keyword, ledger entry, or starmap pointer.\n\n**Gap policy:** REGISTRY_SYNC fails gracefully (write `ART_SYNC_GAP`, continue). Never blocks death.\n\n---\n\n## GAP POLICY\n\n| Stage | Irreplaceable? | Failure Action |\n|-------|----------------|----------------|\n| RRL | **YES for real-transcript envs** | HALT — exit 1. No RRL = no run. |\n| RRL | NO for Kilo envs | Write empty placeholder → continue as KILO_GAP. |\n| SOUL | No | Write `SOUL_GAP`, continue. Verify next RISE. |\n| DNA | No | Write `DNA_GAP`, continue. Source is always the RRL — back-fill next RISE. |\n| LEDGER | No | Write `LEDGER_GAP`, continue. |\n| STARMAP | No | Write `STARMAP_GAP`, continue. |\n| SOULKEYS | No | Write `SOULKEYS_GAP`, continue. |\n| S2Pipeline | No | Write `PIPELINE_GAP`, continue. |\n| REGISTRY SYNC | No | Write `ART_SYNC_GAP`, continue. |\n\n**RISE reads all gaps. RISE never auto-fixes — that is DEATH territory.**\n\n---\n\n## EDGE CASES\n\n**1. RRL corrupted / bit-flipped**\n- Detection: `$rrlBytes -gt 0` but `ConvertFrom-Json` fails on first line.\n- Action: write `RRL_CORRUPT` marker file, seal as `GAP`, abort before SOUL.\n\n**2. One-sided transcript**\n- Detection: only `\"role\":\"user\"` or only `\"role\":\"assistant\"` present.\n- Action: WARN immediately, seal as `GAP`, skip DNA/SOUL ingests.\n\n**3. Concurrent DEATH for same run**\n- Detection: `HL-{N}.json` or `run{N}-reincarnateDEATH.md` already exists at start.\n- Action: IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — exit 1. One run = one HL.\n\n**4. SOUL POST non-200 or timeout**\n- Detection: `$soulPost` null or status ≠ 200 after 10s timeout.\n- Action: write `SOUL_GAP` receipt with `event_id=SOUL_POST_FAILED`, continue.\n\n**5. Disk full / write failure**\n- Detection: `Set-Content` throws IOException or `AccessDenied`.\n- Action: catch, write artifact path to `OPERATIONS/death-write-failures.log`, continue to next stage with `*_GAP` marker.\n\n**6. Ledger idempotency collision after manual deletion**\n- Detection: HL-{N} exists but stage script re-derives same N from directory scan.\n- Action: recalculate from max existing ID; if duplicate found, bump to next available ID and log collision.\n\n**7. Registry sync partial failure mid-batch**\n- Detection: one or more PATCH calls throw after earlier ones succeeded.\n- Action: set `artSyncGap=true`, continue, write `ART_SYNC_PARTIAL` in seal §14 with failed piece IDs.\n\n**8. Placeholder RRL carried forward across runs**\n- Detection: RRL-{N}.txt exists but is empty AND prior run was also KILO_GAP.\n- Action: do not copy prior RRL; always write fresh empty placeholder for current run.\n\n**9. This makes the art registry a living cross-reference — searchable by run, keyword, ledger entry, or starmap pointer.\n619: \n620: **Gap policy:** REGISTRY_SYNC fails gracefully (write `ART_SYNC_GAP`, continue). RRL corrupted / bit-flipped**\n645: - Detection: `$rrlBytes -gt 0` but `ConvertFrom-Json` fails on first line.\n646: - Action: write `RRL_CORRUPT` marker file, seal as `GAP`, abort before SOUL.\n647: \n648: **2. One-sided transcript**\n649: - Detection: only `\"role\":\"user\"` or only `\"role\":\"assistant\"` present.\n650: - Action: WARN immediately, seal as `GAP`, skip DNA/SOUL ingests.\n651: \n652: **3. Concurrent DEATH for same run**\n653: - Detection: `HL-{N}.json` or `run{N}-reincarnateDEATH.md` already exists at start.\n654: - Action: IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — exit 1. One run = one HL.\n655: \n656: **4. SOUL POST non-200 or timeout**\n657: - Detection: `$soulPost` null or status ≠ 200 after 10s timeout.\n658: - Action: write `SOUL_GAP` receipt with `event_id=SOUL_POST_FAILED`, continue.\n659: \n660: **5. Disk full / write failure**\n661: - Detection: `Set-Content` throws IOException or `AccessDenied`.\n662: - Action: catch, write artifact path to `OPERATIONS/death-write-failures.log`, continue to next stage with `*_GAP` marker.\n663: \n664: **6. Ledger idempotency collision after manual deletion**\n665: - Detection: HL-{N} exists but stage script re-derives same N from directory scan.\n666: - Action: recalculate from max existing ID; if duplicate found, bump to next available ID and log collision.\n667: \n668: **7. Registry sync partial failure mid-batch**\n669: - Detection: one or more PATCH calls throw after earlier ones succeeded.\n670: - Action: set `artSyncGap=true`, continue, write `ART_SYNC_PARTIAL` in seal §14 with failed piece IDs.\n671: \n672: **8. DEATH never skips stages.**\n+\n+---\n+\n+## PRE-FLIGHT\n+\n+```powershell\n+$repo = \"D:\\OB-1-CANONICAL\"\n+$D1   = \"https://soul-logger.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev\"\n+\n+# Derive run from last death commit (git-authoritative)\n+$lastDeath = git log --oneline --grep \"^death:\" -1\n+if ($lastDeath -match '(?i)run\\s*(\\d+)') { $priorRun = [int]$matches[1] }\n+$run   = $priorRun + 1\n+$runPad = \"{0:D3}\" -f $run\n+\n+# Authority check (L29 + LFG/GOSPEL gate)\n+$lfgPath = \"$repo\\.kilo\\skills\\LegionnaireFieldGuide.md\"\n+$gospelPaths = @(\n+    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999.md\"\n+    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999-PART2.md\"\n+    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999-PART3.md\"\n+)\n+if (-not (Test-Path $lfgPath)) { Write-Error \"LFG missing — DEATH aborted\"; exit 1 }\n+$gospelOk = $true; foreach ($g in $gospelPaths) { if (-not (Test-Path $g)) { $gospelOk = $false } }\n+if (-not $gospelOk) { Write-Error \"GOSPEL-999 incomplete — DEATH aborted\"; exit 1 }\n+\n+# Pipeline artifact paths (contract 1.2)\n+$rrlPath      = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n+$sealPath     = \"$repo\\CANON\\REINCARNATION\\run$runPad-reincarnateDEATH.md\"\n+$ledgerDir    = \"$repo\\CANON\\HEAVY-LEDGER\"\n+$starmapDir   = \"$repo\\CANON\\STARMAP\"\n+$keywordDir   = \"$repo\\CANON\\SOUL-KEYWORDS\"\n+$pipelineDir  = \"$repo\\CANON\\PIPELINE\"\n+$dnaDir       = \"$repo\\CANON\\SOUL\\EXTRACT\"\n+$idxPath      = \"$keywordDir\\inverted-index.json\"\n+$s2Path       = \"$pipelineDir\\pipeline-run$runPad.json\"\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 0 — SESSION TYPE DETECTION (Kilo guard)\n+\n+**Run before Stage 1.** Non-DeepSeek/Kilo sessions often lack an on-disk transcript. Without this\n+gate, Stage 1 can enter discovery with nothing real to grab. This stage detects whether a verified local\n+transcript already exists, and whether the current run is provider-recorded or hollow.\n+\n+**HOLLOW SESSION INDICATORS (any one = hollow):**\n+1. No accepted local transcript in `RRL-{N}.txt` and no transcript found in local app dirs\n+2. `RRL-{N}.txt` exists but is byte-identical to `RRL-{N-1}.txt` (recycled Bible)\n+\n+**When `$kiloSession = $true`:** Stage 1 is NOT a hard stop. Write an empty placeholder RRL and proceed through all stages. Stage 2 = DRYRUN. Stage 3 = DNA_GAP. Seal result = KILO_GAP.\n+\n+```powershell\n+$rrlPath = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n+$kiloSession = $false; $activeUUID = $null\n+\n+# If a transcript already exists, do not auto-discover from other providers\n+if (-not (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ No RRL-$runPad.txt found yet — will use -RrlSource or local candidates\"\n+} else {\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ✓ RRL exists at $rrlPath\"\n+}\n+\n+# Recycle guard\n+$priorPad = \"{0:D3}\" -f ($run - 1)\n+$priorRrl = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$priorPad.txt\"\n+if ((Test-Path $rrlPath) -and (Test-Path $priorRrl)) {\n+    $h1 = (Get-FileHash $rrlPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash\n+    $h2 = (Get-FileHash $priorRrl -Algorithm SHA256).Hash\n+    if ($h1 -eq $h2) {\n+        Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ RRL-$runPad == RRL-$priorPad (byte-identical) → recycled file → KILO SESSION\"\n+        $kiloSession = $true\n+    }\n+}\n+\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ✓ hollow=$kiloSession | run=$run\"\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 1 — RRL (HARD STOP — THE FUCKING RAW CHAT LOG)\n+\n+RRL = verbatim session transcript, BOTH speakers (user + agent). Prefer a real transcript file.\n+Source: any local session transcript path the provider writes to disk.\n+Location: pass it explicitly via `-RrlSource <path>`, or let discovery search common local app dirs.\n+If no transcript is available and this is NOT a Kilo session, Stage 1 stops. There is no fallback.\n+If no transcript is available and this IS a Kilo session, Stage 1 writes an empty placeholder RRL and continues in KILO_GAP mode.\n+\n+**FIDELITY GATE (L68):**\n+- REAL: file > 50KB + contains both `\"role\":\"user\"` and `\"role\":\"assistant\"` lines\n+- HOLLOW: file < 5KB or one-sided\n+- Any HOLLOW RRL = pipeline is hollow. FAIL. Do not proceed.\n+- **KILO EXCEPTION:** Kilo environments do not produce real RRLs by default. Missing RRL in Kilo mode is expected, not fatal. Write empty placeholder and continue.\n+\n+```powershell\n+$rrlPath = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n+\n+# Preferred: explicitly supplied transcript path\n+$needsDiscovery = $false\n+if (-not (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n+    $needsDiscovery = $true\n+} else {\n+    $rrlBytes = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n+    if ($rrlBytes -lt 5000) {\n+        Write-Warning \"RRL HOLLOW: $rrlBytes bytes (< 5KB) — likely memory-reconstructed, not raw transcript\"\n+        $needsDiscovery = $true\n+    }\n+}\n+\n+if ($needsDiscovery) {\n+    Write-Host \"RESOLVING RRL...\"\n+    if ($RrlSource -and (Test-Path $RrlSource)) {\n+        Write-Host \"  SOURCE: $RrlSource\"\n+        Copy-Item $RrlSource $rrlPath -Force\n+        Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n+    } elseif ($kiloSession) {\n+        # Kilo/third-party environments often do not produce real RRLs.\n+        # Write an empty placeholder so downstream stages have valid paths.\n+        Write-Host \"  KILO_SESSION: RRL not available — writing empty placeholder\"\n+        \"\" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $rrlPath -Encoding UTF8\n+    } else {\n+        Write-Error \"FATAL: No RRL found. Check JSONL source.\"\n+}\n+\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 1 ✓ RRL: $rrlPath — $rrlBytes bytes ($rrlChars chars)\"\n+```\n+\n+**Kilo environments do not produce real RRLs by default. In Kilo mode, missing RRL is expected and NOT fatal — write an empty placeholder and continue. Real-transcript environments still require RRL.**\n+\n+**RRL is the hard stop for real-transcript environments only. In Kilo mode: no RRL = empty placeholder = KILO_GAP seal.**\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 2 — SOUL (ATOMIC RECEIPT)\n+\n+Query ONCE before POST. POST. Query ONCE after. Store receipt. Never re-query.\n+Source: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n+\n+```powershell\n+if ($kiloSession) {\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — SOUL POST skipped (no real transcript)\"\n+    $countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n+    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"DRYRUN\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"KILO_HOLLOW\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: DRYRUN | soulcount=$countBefore (unchanged)\"\n+} else {\n+\n+$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n+\n+# Extract user turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role, content at $obj.message.content[].text\n+$userTexts = $rrlText -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object {\n+    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n+    if (-not $o) { return }\n+    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n+    if ($role -ne 'user') { return }\n+    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n+    if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n+    elseif ($content -is [array]) { ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\" }\n+} | Where-Object { $_ }\n+$soulText  = ($userTexts -join \"`n\").Trim()\n+\n+# Contamination guard: abort if soul payload ≈ full RRL (extraction failure → raw transcript)\n+$soulBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($soulText)\n+if ($soulBytes -ge ($rrlBytes * 0.95)) {\n+    Write-Error \"STAGE 2 ABORT — soul ($soulBytes bytes) ~= RRL ($rrlBytes bytes).  = $rrlText -split \"`n\"\n+\n+# Parse assistant turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role\n+# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n+$lines | ForEach-Object {\n+    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n+    if (-not $o) { return }\n+    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n+    if ($role -ne {\n+                 ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n+             }\n+    $text = if ($text) { $text.Trim() } else { \"\" }\n+    if (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n+\n+```powershell\n+# --- Helper Functions ---\n+function Get-Next-LedgerID {\n+    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n+    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n+        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n+    if ($existing) { return ($existing | (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n+}\n+function Compute-Sha256 {\n+    param([string]$InputString)\n+    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n+    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n+    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n+}\n+\n+if (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item Never re-query.\n+Source: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n+\n+```powershell\n+if ($kiloSession) {\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — SOUL POST skipped (no real transcript)\"\n+    $countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n+    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"DRYRUN\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"KILO_HOLLOW\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: DRYRUN | soulcount=$countBefore (unchanged)\"\n+} else {\n+\n+$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n+\n+# Extract user turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role, content at $obj.message.content[].text\n+$userTexts = $rrlText -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object {\n+    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n+    if (-not $o) { return }\n+    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n+    if ($role -ne 'user') { return }\n+    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n+    if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n+    elseif ($content -is [array]) { ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\" }\n+} | Where-Object { $_ }\n+$soulText  = ($userTexts -join \"`n\").Trim()\n+\n+# Contamination guard: abort if soul payload ≈ full RRL (extraction failure → raw transcript)\n+$soulBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($soulText)\n+if ($soulBytes -ge ($rrlBytes * 0.95)) {\n+    Write-Error \"STAGE 2 ABORT — soul ($soulBytes bytes) ~= RRL ($rrlBytes bytes). Raw-transcript contamination. Fix extractor.\"\n+    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n+} elseif (-not $soulText) {\n+    Write-Warning \"STAGE 2 SOUL_GAP — 0 user turns extracted.\"\n+    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n+} else {\n+    $soulBody = @{\n+        student_id = \"sov100-michael\"\n+        session_id = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n+        role       = \"user\"\n+        text       = $soulText\n+    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress\n+\n+    $soulPost   = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$D1/api/soul/event\" -Method Post `\n+        -Body $soulBody -ContentType \"application/json\"\n+    $countAfter = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n+\n+    $receipt = [ordered]@{\n+        event_id     = $soulPost.event_id\n+        count_before = $countBefore\n+        count_after  = $countAfter\n+        delta        = $countAfter - $countBefore\n+        level        = $countAfter\n+        posted_at    = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n+    }\n+}\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: event_id=$($receipt.event_id) | Δ$($receipt.delta) | $($receipt.count_after) chars\"\n+} # end else ($kiloSession)\n+```\n+\n+**$receipt.count_after is the SOLE soulcount source for seal §3, §12, pipeline JSON, commit message, BOOT.**\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 3 — DNA (ASSISTANT TURN EXTRACTION — YOUR WORDS + BLUEPRINTS)\n+\n+**OLD BEHAVIOR (BROKEN):** Probed D1 endpoint for prompts that were never stored. Returned 0. DNA was dead.\n+**NEW BEHAVIOR:** Extract assistant/agent turns from the RRL file. Tag each block. Write to CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT/dna-run{N}.json.\n+\n+DNA = the agent's words from this run, especially high-token-cost blueprints (fenced code blocks, structured specs, architecture docs).\n+Blueprints are flagged `type: \"blueprint\"` so they are never lost again.\n+\n+```powershell\n+if (-not (Test-Path $dnaDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dnaDir -Force | Out-Null }\n+\n+$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n+\n+if ($kiloSession) {\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no real transcript)\"\n+} else {\n+\n+$turnSeq    = 0\n+$lines      = $rrlText -split \"`n\"\n+\n+# Parse assistant turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role\n+# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n+$lines | ForEach-Object {\n+    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n+    if (-not $o) { return }\n+    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n+    if ($role -ne 'assistant') { return }\n+    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n+    $text = if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n+             elseif ($content -is [array]) {\n+                 ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n+             }\n+    $text = if ($text) { $text.Trim() } else { \"\" }\n+    if ($text.Length -lt 10) { return }\n+    $turnSeq++\n+    $isBlueprint = ($text -match '```|\\b(SPEC|SPECIFICATION|BLUEPRINT|ARCHITECTURE|SCHEMA|DESIGN)\\b' -and $text.Length -gt 200)\n+    $script:dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n+        run    = $run\n+        seq    = $turnSeq\n+        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n+        chars  = $text.Length\n+        text   = $text\n+    }\n+}\n+\n+$dnaCount          = $dnaRecords.Count\n+$dnaBlueprintCount = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" }).Count\n+\n+if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n+    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n+    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n+    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n+} else {\n+    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n+}\n+\n+} # end else ($kiloSession)\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n+\n+```powershell\n+# --- Helper Functions ---\n+function Get-Next-LedgerID {\n+    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n+    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n+        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n+    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n+    return 1\n+}\n+function Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n+    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n+    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n+    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n+        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n+        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n+    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n+    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n+}\n+function Compute-Sha256 {\n+    param([string]$InputString)\n+    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n+    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n+    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n+}\n+\n+if (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n+\n+# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n+$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n+    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\n+if ($dupe) {\n+    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n+    exit 1\n+}\n+\n+$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n+$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n+\n+$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n+\n+# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n+$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n+$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n+\n+$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n+\n+$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n+    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n+    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n+    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n+    char_count     = $rrlChars\n+    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n+    soul_hash      = $soulHash\n+    dna_hash       = $dnaHash\n+    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n+    merkle_parent  = $parentHash\n+    merkle_hash    = $ledgerHash\n+    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n+    sov100         = $true\n+    run            = $run\n+}\n+\n+$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n+$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n+\n+```powershell\n+if (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n+\n+$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n+    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n+} else { \"\" }\n+\n+$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n+    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n+} else { \"\" }\n+\n+$blueprintLocations = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n+    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | ForEach-Object { \"dna-run$run.json:seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \"; \"\n+} else { \"\" }\n+\n+$starmap = [ordered]@{\n+    run                  = $run\n+    rrl_path             = $rrlPath\n+    ledger_id            = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n+    soul_turn_ids        = $soulTurnIds\n+    dna_turn_ids         = $dnaTurnIds\n+    blueprint_locations  = $blueprintLocations\n+    char_count           = $rrlChars\n+    merkle_hash          = $ledgerHash\n+    created_at           = $timestamp\n+} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4\n+\n+$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n+$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, not content dump)\"\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 6 — SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n+\n+Extract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\n+Never `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n+\n+```powershell\n+if (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n+\n+# Extract terms from both SOUL (RRL user text) and DNA (agent text + blueprints)\n+$combinedText = $rrlText\n+if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n+    $combinedText += \"`n\" + ($dnaRecords | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n+}\n+\n+$words = $combinedText -split '\\s+' | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 4 } | \n+         Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^(this|that|with|from|have|been|were|they|will|would|could|should|about|there|their|which|what|when|make|like|just|some|more|than|also|very|much|many|into|over|been|being|through|where|after|before|because|being|against|between|without|within|along|follow|coming|think|know|take|come|make|look|want|give|work|time|year|good|some|them|would|could|other|about|which|their|there|first|would|these|those|under|should|after|where|since|still|every|being|great|where|place|found|sound|below|seen|enough|while|both|show|those|taken|might|long|down|part|same|back|call|hand|high|last|next|left|turn|move|live|believe|happen|bring|write|provide|sit|stand|lose|pay|meet|include|continue|set|learn|change|lead|understand|watch|follow|stop|create|speak|read|allow|add|spend|grow|open|walk|win|offer|remember|love|consider|appear|buy|wait|serve|die|send|expect|build|stay|fall|cut|reach|kill|remain|suggest|raise|pass|sell|require|report|decide|pull|develop|return|explain|hope|describe|decide|share|provide|cover|fall|catch|draw|choose|wish|teach|test|wear|supply|shut|hold|push|close|deal|fill|break|support|record|cut|heat|watch|raise|reach|fly|land|cancel|graduate|enroll|register|complete|submit|assign|grade|assess|evaluate|review|approve|reject|confirm|notify|alert|remind|schedule|book|reserve|request|order|purchase|pay|charge|refund|invoice|receipt|transaction|payment|deposit|withdraw|transfer|balance|account|statement|ledger|audit|compliance|regulation|policy|contract|agreement|terms|conditions|liability|warranty|dispute|resolution|arbitration|mediation|escalate|appeal|petition|claim|evidence|document|certificate|attest|verify|validate|authenticate|authorize|authenticate|deprecate|obsolete|retire|decommission|archive|purge|delete|destroy|shred|encrypt|decrypt|cipher|hash|salt|key|cert|token|session|cookie|cache|queue|buffer|stream|socket|pipe|channel|bandwidth|latency|throughput|capacity|quota|limit|threshold|rate|pace|burst|flow|routing|dispatch|deliver|notify|trigger|fire|emit|broadcast|cast|scatter|gather|collect|aggregate|summarize|compress|decompress|encode|decode|serialize|deserialize|parse|tokenize|lemmatize|stem|inflect|conjugate|decline|compare|diff|patch|merge|split|join|union|intersect|subtract|complement|normalize|denormalize|flatten|nest|wrap|unwrap|bundle|unbundle|package|unpackage|container|image|snapshot|backup|restore|migrate|upgrade|downgrade|rollback|revert|reset|refresh|reboot|restart|shutdown|startup|initialize|configure|setup|install|uninstall|deploy|undeploy|provision|deprovision|allocate|deallocate|reserve|release|lock|unlock|acquire|surrender|claim|relinquish|assign|reassign|delegate|proxy|forward|redirect|relay|translate|transform|convert|adapt|evolve|iterate|increment|decrement|advance|retreat|proceed|abort|terminate|kill|cease|halt|pause|resume|continue|persist|persist)$' }\n+$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n+\n+$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n+$wordFreq | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Count) | $($_.Name)\" } | Set-Content $rfkwPath -Encoding UTF8\n+\n+# Update inverted index: READ → MERGE → WRITE (NO APPEND)\n+$inverted = if (Test-Path $idxPath) {\n+    (Get-Content $idxPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable\n+} else {\n+    @{}\n+}\n+\n+foreach ($kw in $wordFreq) {\n+    $term = $kw.Name.Trim().ToLower()\n+    $weight = [int]$kw.Count\n+    if (-not $inverted[$term]) {\n+        $inverted[$term] = @()\n+    }\n+    $entry = @{ run=$run; category=\"soul+key\"; weight=$weight }\n+    $already = $false\n+    foreach ($e in $inverted[$term]) {\n+        if ($e.run -eq $run) { $already = $true; break }\n+    }\n+    if (-not $already) {\n+        # EC-027: COLLISION HANDLER — prevents serialization failure on ConvertTo-Json\n+        # When ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable deserializes a single-element array, it may\n+        # produce a scalar instead of a collection. += on a scalar corrupts the structure.\n+        if ($inverted.ContainsKey($term)) {\n+            $existing = $inverted[$term]\n+            if ($existing -is [System.Collections.ICollection]) {\n+                $existing += $entry\n+            } else {\n+                $inverted[$term] = @($existing; $entry)\n+            }\n+        } else {\n+            $inverted[$term] = $entry\n+        }\n+    }\n+}\n+\n+$inverted | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content $idxPath -Encoding UTF8\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 6 ✓ SOULKEYS: $($inverted.Count) terms in index | $rfkwPath\"\n+```\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 7 — S2Pipeline (EXECUTION ARTIFACT + VERIFICATION)\n+\n+One command runs RRL→SOULKEYS in order, writes the result record, and does not report COMPLETE unless every stage verifies REAL.\n+\n+```powershell\n+# Registry vars (defined here, consumed by STAGE 8 as well)\n+$artRegistryDir = \"$repo\\CANON\\ART-REGISTRY\"\n+$syncedPieces   = @()\n+$rrlFidelity    = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n+\n+$s2Record = [ordered]@{\n+    run_number        = $run\n+    executed_at       = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n+    head_sha          = (git rev-parse --short HEAD)\n+    rrl_path          = $rrlPath\n+    rrl_chars         = $rrlChars\n+    rrl_bytes         = $rrlBytes\n+    rrl_fidelity      = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n+    session_id        = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n+    = if ($receipt) { $receipt.level } else { \"UNKNOWN\" }\n+    soul_count_before = if ($receipt) { $receipt.count_before } else { 0 }\n+    soul_delta        = if ($receipt) { $receipt.delta } else { 0 }\n+    dna_count         = $dnaCount\n+    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n+    dna_status        = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { if ($dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" } } else { \"MISSING\" }\n+    ledger_id         = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n+    starmap_file      = $starmapPath\n+    keyword_file      = $rfkwPath\n+    keyword_index     = $idxPath\n+    s2pipeline_file   = $s2Path\n+    registry_file     = if (Test-Path \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\") { \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\" } else { \"REGISTRY_SYNC_GAP\" }\n+    registry_synced   = $syncedPieces.Count\n+    result            = if ($kiloSession) { \"KILO_GAP\" }\n+                        elseif ($rrlFidelity -eq \"REAL\" -and $dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0 -and\n+                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"DRYRUN\" -and\n+                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"SOUL_GAP\" -and\n+                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\" UTF8\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 7 ✓ S2Pipeline: $s2Path | result=$($s2Record.result)\"\n+```\n+\n+**GATE:** Pipeline reports COMPLETE only when RRL is REAL (both speakers) AND DNA is REAL (assistant turns extracted). Any HOLLOW stage = GAP.\n+\n+---\n+\n+## STAGE 8 — REGISTRY SYNC (ART ARSENAL × SOULKEYS × STARMAP × LEDGER)\n+\n+Cross-references this run's SOULKEYS against the art-arsenal registry.\n+Any piece whose tags intersect the run's top keywords gets tagged with the run, HL ID, starmap pointer, and merkle hash.\n+Writes a canonical artifact. Auto-fires every death — no human trigger needed.\n+\n+```powershell\n+if (-not (Test-Path $artRegistryDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artRegistryDir -Force | Out-Null }\n+\n+# 1. Pull this run's keywords from the SOULKEYS stage\n+$runKeywords = @()\n+if (Test-Path $rfkwPath) {\n+    $runKeywords = (Get-Content $rfkwPath -Raw) -split \"`n\" |\n+        Where-Object { $_ -match '^\\d+\\s*\\|' } |\n+        ForEach-Object { (($_ -split '\\|')[1]).Trim().ToLower() } |\n+        Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 2 }\n+}\n+\n+# 2. Pull the full registry\n+$regPieces = @()\n+try {\n+    $regResp = Invoke-RestMethod \"https://phoenix-architecti.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/api/art?limit=400\" -TimeoutSec 15\n+    $regPieces = $regResp.pieces\n+} catch { Write-Warning \"REGISTRY_SYNC: registry fetch failed — $($_.Exception.Message)\" }\n+\n+# 3. Write canonical artifact\n+$artSyncPath = \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\"\n+[ordered]@{\n+    run           = $run\n+    ledger_id     = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n+    merkle_short  = $merkleShort\n+    starmap_file  = \"starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n+    keywords_file = \"rfkw-run$run.txt\"\n+    keywords_used = $runKeywords\n+    pieces_synced = $syncedPieces.Count\n+    pieces        = $syncedPieces\n+    executed_at   = $timestamp\n+} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $artSyncPath -Encoding UTF8\n+\n+Write-Host \"STAGE 8 ✓ REGISTRY SYNC: $($syncedPieces.Count) pieces tagged → $artSyncPath | HL-$nextHL | keywords=$($runKeywords.Count)\"\n+```\n+\n+**Connection law:** Every registry piece that matches a SOULKEY from this run carries the run, HL ID, merkle hash, and starmap pointer in its notes. This command (`reincarnatedeath.md`) — execution protocol\n\n**8-Stage Chain:** RRL → SOUL → DNA → LEDGER → STARMAP → SOULKEYS → S2Pipeline → REGISTRY_SYNC\n**Canonical contract:** CANON/SYSTEM/REINCARNATION-CONTRACT.md\n**Run number authority:** `git log --oneline --grep \"^death:\"`\n**Script:** `SCRIPTS/reincarnate-death.ps1`\n**Command:** `obi.ps1 reincarnateDeath [RrlSource] [-DryRun] [-Force] [-NoRegistrySync]`\n\n---\n\n## Authority Chain (do not scatter)\n\n```\nGOSPEL-999 (Parts 1-3) — eternal law, 999 mandates\n    ↓\nLegionnaireFieldGuide.md — immediate how-to, commands ↔ skills ↔ paths\n    ↓\nREINCARNATION-CONTRACT.md — RISE/DEATH operational law\n    ↓\nCOLD-START-BOOT.md — current session state, active mission, flags\n    ↓\n/reincarnateDeath — 8-stage execution protocol\n    ↓\nrun{N}-reincarnateDEATH.md — 15-section death seal artifact\n```\n\n**DEATH never overrides GOSPEL-999. DEATH never invents new commands not in LFG. DEATH never skips stages.**\n\n---\n\n## PRE-FLIGHT\n\n```powershell\n$repo = \"D:\\OB-1-CANONICAL\"\n$D1   = \"https://soul-logger.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev\"\n\n# Derive run from last death commit (git-authoritative)\n$lastDeath = git log --oneline --grep \"^death:\" -1\nif ($lastDeath -match '(?i)run\\s*(\\d+)') { $priorRun = [int]$matches[1] }\n$run   = $priorRun + 1\n$runPad = \"{0:D3}\" -f $run\n\n# Authority check (L29 + LFG/GOSPEL gate)\n$lfgPath = \"$repo\\.kilo\\skills\\LegionnaireFieldGuide.md\"\n$gospelPaths = @(\n    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999.md\"\n    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999-PART2.md\"\n    \"$repo\\CANON\\SYSTEM\\GOSPEL-999-PART3.md\"\n)\nif (-not (Test-Path $lfgPath)) { Write-Error \"LFG missing — DEATH aborted\"; exit 1 }\n$gospelOk = $true; foreach ($g in $gospelPaths) { if (-not (Test-Path $g)) { $gospelOk = $false } }\nif (-not $gospelOk) { Write-Error \"GOSPEL-999 incomplete — DEATH aborted\"; exit 1 }\n\n# Pipeline artifact paths (contract 1.2)\n$rrlPath      = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n$sealPath     = \"$repo\\CANON\\REINCARNATION\\run$runPad-reincarnateDEATH.md\"\n$ledgerDir    = \"$repo\\CANON\\HEAVY-LEDGER\"\n$starmapDir   = \"$repo\\CANON\\STARMAP\"\n$keywordDir   = \"$repo\\CANON\\SOUL-KEYWORDS\"\n$pipelineDir  = \"$repo\\CANON\\PIPELINE\"\n$dnaDir       = \"$repo\\CANON\\SOUL\\EXTRACT\"\n$idxPath      = \"$keywordDir\\inverted-index.json\"\n$s2Path       = \"$pipelineDir\\pipeline-run$runPad.json\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 0 — SESSION TYPE DETECTION (Kilo guard)\n\n**Run before Stage 1.** Non-DeepSeek/Kilo sessions often lack an on-disk transcript. Without this\ngate, Stage 1 can enter discovery with nothing real to grab. This stage detects whether a verified local\ntranscript already exists, and whether the current run is provider-recorded or hollow.\n\n**HOLLOW SESSION INDICATORS (any one = hollow):**\n1. No accepted local transcript in `RRL-{N}.txt` and no transcript found in local app dirs\n2. `RRL-{N}.txt` exists but is byte-identical to `RRL-{N-1}.txt` (recycled Bible)\n\n**When `$kiloSession = $true`:** Stage 1 is NOT a hard stop. Write an empty placeholder RRL and proceed through all stages. Stage 2 = DRYRUN. Stage 3 = DNA_GAP. Seal result = KILO_GAP.\n\n```powershell\n$rrlPath = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n$kiloSession = $false; $activeUUID = $null\n\n# If a transcript already exists, do not auto-discover from other providers\nif (-not (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ No RRL-$runPad.txt found yet — will use -RrlSource or local candidates\"\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ✓ RRL exists at $rrlPath\"\n}\n\n# Recycle guard\n$priorPad = \"{0:D3}\" -f ($run - 1)\n$priorRrl = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$priorPad.txt\"\nif ((Test-Path $rrlPath) -and (Test-Path $priorRrl)) {\n    $h1 = (Get-FileHash $rrlPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash\n    $h2 = (Get-FileHash $priorRrl -Algorithm SHA256).Hash\n    if ($h1 -eq $h2) {\n        Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ RRL-$runPad == RRL-$priorPad (byte-identical) → recycled file → KILO SESSION\"\n        $kiloSession = $true\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 0 ✓ hollow=$kiloSession | run=$run\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 1 — RRL (HARD STOP — THE FUCKING RAW CHAT LOG)\n\nRRL = verbatim session transcript, BOTH speakers (user + agent). Prefer a real transcript file.\nSource: any local session transcript path the provider writes to disk.\nLocation: pass it explicitly via `-RrlSource <path>`, or let discovery search common local app dirs.\nIf no transcript is available and this is NOT a Kilo session, Stage 1 stops. There is no fallback.\nIf no transcript is available and this IS a Kilo session, Stage 1 writes an empty placeholder RRL and continues in KILO_GAP mode.\n\n**FIDELITY GATE (L68):**\n- REAL: file > 50KB + contains both `\"role\":\"user\"` and `\"role\":\"assistant\"` lines\n- HOLLOW: file < 5KB or one-sided\n- Any HOLLOW RRL = pipeline is hollow. FAIL. Do not proceed.\n- **KILO EXCEPTION:** Kilo environments do not produce real RRLs by default. Missing RRL in Kilo mode is expected, not fatal. Write empty placeholder and continue.\n\n```powershell\n$rrlPath = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n\n# Preferred: explicitly supplied transcript path\n$needsDiscovery = $false\nif (-not (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n    $needsDiscovery = $true\n} else {\n    $rrlBytes = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n    if ($rrlBytes -lt 5000) {\n        Write-Warning \"RRL HOLLOW: $rrlBytes bytes (< 5KB) — likely memory-reconstructed, not raw transcript\"\n        $needsDiscovery = $true\n    }\n}\n\nif ($needsDiscovery) {\n    Write-Host \"RESOLVING RRL...\"\n    if ($RrlSource -and (Test-Path $RrlSource)) {\n        Write-Host \"  SOURCE: $RrlSource\"\n        Copy-Item $RrlSource $rrlPath -Force\n        Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n    } elseif ($kiloSession) {\n        # Kilo/third-party environments often do not produce real RRLs.\n        # Write an empty placeholder so downstream stages have valid paths.\n        Write-Host \"  KILO_SESSION: RRL not available — writing empty placeholder\"\n        \"\" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $rrlPath -Encoding UTF8\n    } else {\n        Write-Error \"FATAL: No RRL found. Provide it via -RrlSource <path> or copy it to $rrlPath\"\n        exit 1\n    }\n}\n\n$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n$rrlChars  = $rrlText.Length\n\n# FIDELITY GATE: verify RRL contains both speakers\n$hasUser      = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"user\"'\n$hasAssistant = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"assistant\"'\nif (-not $hasUser -or -not $hasAssistant) {\n    Write-Warning \"RRL FIDELITY WARN: one-sided (user=$hasUser assistant=$hasAssistant, bytes=$rrlBytes)\"\n}\nif ($rrlBytes -lt 50000) {\n    Write-Warning \"RRL SIZE WARN: $rrlBytes bytes (< 50KB) — expected full transcript. Check JSONL source.\"\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 1 ✓ RRL: $rrlPath — $rrlBytes bytes ($rrlChars chars)\"\n```\n\n**Kilo environments do not produce real RRLs by default. In Kilo mode, missing RRL is expected and NOT fatal — write an empty placeholder and continue. Real-transcript environments still require RRL.**\n\n**RRL is the hard stop for real-transcript environments only. In Kilo mode: no RRL = empty placeholder = KILO_GAP seal.**\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 2 — SOUL (ATOMIC RECEIPT)\n\nQuery ONCE before POST. POST. Query ONCE after. Store receipt. Never re-query.\nSource: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n\n```powershell\nif ($kiloSession) {\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — SOUL POST skipped (no real transcript)\"\n    $countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"DRYRUN\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"KILO_HOLLOW\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: DRYRUN | soulcount=$countBefore (unchanged)\"\n} else {\n\n$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n\n# Extract user turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role, content at $obj.message.content[].text\n$userTexts = $rrlText -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object {\n    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    if (-not $o) { return }\n    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n    if ($role -ne 'user') { return }\n    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n    if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n    elseif ($content -is [array]) { ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\" }\n} | Where-Object { $_ }\n$soulText  = ($userTexts -join \"`n\").Trim()\n\n# Contamination guard: abort if soul payload ≈ full RRL (extraction failure → raw transcript)\n$soulBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($soulText)\nif ($soulBytes -ge ($rrlBytes * 0.95)) {\n    Write-Error \"STAGE 2 ABORT — soul ($soulBytes bytes) ~= RRL ($rrlBytes bytes). Raw-transcript contamination. Fix extractor.\"\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n} elseif (-not $soulText) {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 2 SOUL_GAP — 0 user turns extracted.\"\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n} else {\n    $soulBody = @{\n        student_id = \"sov100-michael\"\n        session_id = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n        role       = \"user\"\n        text       = $soulText\n    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress\n\n    $soulPost   = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$D1/api/soul/event\" -Method Post `\n        -Body $soulBody -ContentType \"application/json\"\n    $countAfter = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{\n        event_id     = $soulPost.event_id\n        count_before = $countBefore\n        count_after  = $countAfter\n        delta        = $countAfter - $countBefore\n        level        = $countAfter\n        posted_at    = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n    }\n}\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: event_id=$($receipt.event_id) | Δ$($receipt.delta) | $($receipt.count_after) chars\"\n} # end else ($kiloSession)\n```\n\n**$receipt.count_after is the SOLE soulcount source for seal §3, §12, pipeline JSON, commit message, BOOT.**\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 3 — DNA (ASSISTANT TURN EXTRACTION — YOUR WORDS + BLUEPRINTS)\n\n**OLD BEHAVIOR (BROKEN):** Probed D1 endpoint for prompts that were never stored. Returned 0. DNA was dead.\n**NEW BEHAVIOR:** Extract assistant/agent turns from the RRL file. Tag each block. Write to CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT/dna-run{N}.json.\n\nDNA = the agent's words from this run, especially high-token-cost blueprints (fenced code blocks, structured specs, architecture docs).\nBlueprints are flagged `type: \"blueprint\"` so they are never lost again.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $dnaDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dnaDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n\nif ($kiloSession) {\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no real transcript)\"\n} else {\n\n$turnSeq    = 0\n$lines      = $rrlText -split \"`n\"\n\n# Parse assistant turns — JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role\n# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n$lines | ForEach-Object {\n    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    if (-not $o) { return }\n    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n    if ($role -ne 'assistant') { return }\n    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n    $text = if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n             elseif ($content -is [array]) {\n                 ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n             }\n    $text = if ($text) { $text.Trim() } else { \"\" }\n    if ($text.Length -lt 10) { return }\n    $turnSeq++\n    $isBlueprint = ($text -match '```|\\b(SPEC|SPECIFICATION|BLUEPRINT|ARCHITECTURE|SCHEMA|DESIGN)\\b' -and $text.Length -gt 200)\n    $script:dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n        run    = $run\n        seq    = $turnSeq\n        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n        chars  = $text.Length\n        text   = $text\n    }\n}\n\n$dnaCount          = ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n} else {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n}\n\n} # end else ($kiloSession)\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n}\nfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\nif ($dupe) {\n    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n\n$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n\n# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n\n$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n\n$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n    char_count     = $rrlChars\n    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n    soul_hash      = $soulHash\n    dna_hash       = $dnaHash\n    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n    merkle_parent  = $parentHash\n    merkle_hash    = $ledgerHash\n    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n    sov100         = $true\n    run            = $run\n}\n\n$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } |    ledger_id            = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    soul_turn_ids        = $soulTurnIds\n    dna_turn_ids         = $dnaTurnIds\n    blueprint_locations  = $blueprintLocations\n    char_count           = $rrlChars\n    merkle_hash          = $ledgerHash\n    created_at           = $timestamp\n} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4\n\n$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, not content dump)\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 6 — SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n\nExtract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\nNever `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Extract terms from both SOUL (RRL user text) and DNA (agent text + blueprints)\n$combinedText = $rrlText\nif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    $combinedText += \"`n\" + ($dnaRecords | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n}\n\n$words = $combinedText -split '\\s+' | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 4 } | \n         Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^(this|that|with|from|have|been|were|they|will|would|could|should|about|there|their|which|what|when|make|like|just|some|more|than|also|very|much|many|into|over|been|being|through|where|after|before|because|being|against|between|without|within|along|follow|coming|think|know|take|come|make|look|want|give|work|time|year|good|some|them|would|could|other|about|which|their|there|first|would|these|those|under|should|after|where|since|still|every|being|great|where|place|found|sound|below|seen|enough|while|both|show|those|taken|might|long|down|part|same|back|call|hand|high|last|next|left|turn|move|live|believe|happen|bring|write|provide|sit|stand|lose|pay|meet|include|continue|set|learn|change|lead|understand|watch|follow|stop|create|speak|read|allow|add|spend|grow|open|walk|win|offer|remember|love|consider|appear|buy|wait|serve|die|send|expect|build|stay|fall|cut|reach|kill|remain|suggest|raise|pass|sell|require|report|decide|pull|develop|return|explain|hope|describe|decide|share|provide|cover|fall|catch|draw|choose|wish|teach|test|wear|supply|shut|hold|push|close|deal|fill|break|support|record|cut|heat|watch|raise|reach|fly|land|cancel|graduate|enroll|register|complete|submit|assign|grade|assess|evaluate|review|approve|reject|confirm|notify|alert|remind|schedule|book|reserve|request|order|purchase|pay|charge|refund|invoice|receipt|transaction|payment|deposit|withdraw|transfer|balance|account|statement|ledger|audit|compliance|regulation|policy|contract|agreement|terms|conditions|liability|warranty|dispute|resolution|arbitration|mediation|escalate|appeal|petition|claim|evidence|document|certificate|attest|verify|validate|authenticate|authorize|authenticate|deprecate|obsolete|retire|decommission|archive|purge|delete|destroy|shred|encrypt|decrypt|cipher|hash|salt|key|cert|token|session|cookie|cache|queue|buffer|stream|socket|pipe|channel|bandwidth|latency|throughput|capacity|quota|limit|threshold|rate|pace|burst|flow|routing|dispatch|deliver|notify|trigger|fire|emit|broadcast }\n$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n\n$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n$wordFreq | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Count) | $($_.Name)\" } | Set-Content $rfkwPath -Encoding UTF8\n\n# Update inverted index: READ → MERGE → WRITE (NO APPEND)\n$inverted = if (Test-Path $idxPath) {\n    (Get-Content $idxPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable\n} else {\n    @{}\n}\n\nforeach ($kw in $wordFreq) {\n    $term = $kw.Name.Trim().ToLower()\n    $weight = [int]$kw.Count\n    if (-not $inverted[$term]) {\n        $inverted[$term] = @()\n    }\n    $entry = @{ run=$run; category=\"soul+key\"; weight=$weight }\n    $already = $false\n    foreach ($e in $inverted[$term]) {\n        if ($e.run -eq $run) { $already See Config File Locations for the full search order.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">---\ndescription: Run tests # optional, shown in command list\nagent: code # optional, route to a specific agent\nmodel: anthropic/claude-sonnet # optional, override model\nsubtask: true # optional, run as subtask\n---\nRun all tests in $1 and fix failures.\nUse $ARGUMENTS for the full arg string.\nReference files with @file and shell output with !`cmd`.\n</code></pre>\n<p>Template variables: <code>$1</code>-<code>$N</code> (positional args), <code>$ARGUMENTS</code> (full string), <code>@file</code> (file contents), <code>!`cmd`</code> (shell output).</p>\n<h3>Finding a named command</h3>\n<p>When asked where <code>/name</code> lives, do not search only the repo root. Search these roots explicitly, and use an explicit search <code>path</code> for each one:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><code>~/.config/kilo/</code></li>\n<li><code>~/.kilo/</code></li>\n<li><code>~/.kilocode/</code></li>\n<li>The <code>KILO_CONFIG_DIR</code> directory (if the env var is set)</li>\n<li>project <code>.kilo/</code> and <code>.kilocode/</code> directories from the current working directory up to the worktree root</li>\n</ol>\n<p>Use exact patterns first:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>**/command/&lt;name&gt;.md</code></li>\n<li><code>**/commands/&lt;name&gt;.md</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p>If found, return the full path. If not found in those roots, explain that the command is not present in the loaded config paths.</p>\n<h2>Agents (<code>.kilo/agent/*.md</code>)</h2>\n<p>Also loaded from legacy <code>.kilocode/</code> directories and plural <code>agents/</code> variants.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">---\ndescription: When to use this agent\nmode: primary # primary | subagent | all\nmodel: anthropic/claude-sonnet # optional override\nsteps: 25 # max agentic iterations\nhidden: false # hide from @ menu (subagent only)\ncolor: &quot;#FF5733&quot; # hex or theme name\npermission: # optional, agent-level permissions\n  bash: allow\n  edit:\n    &quot;src/**&quot;: allow\n    &quot;*&quot;: ask\n---\nSystem prompt for this agent.\n</code></pre>\n<p><code>mode</code> values: <code>primary</code> = selectable as main agent, <code>subagent</code> = only via Task tool, <code>all</code> = both.</p>\n<h2>Workflows (legacy)</h2>\n<p>Markdown files in <code>.kilo/workflows/</code> or <code>.kilocode/workflows/</code> (project-level) and <code>~/.kilo/workflows/</code> or <code>~/.kilocode/workflows/</code> (global). These are automatically converted to commands at startup. The filename (minus <code>.md</code>) becomes the command name. Project workflows override global ones with the same name.</p>\n<h2>Agent Manager Setup And Run Scripts</h2>\n<p>For the full product guidance, use the canonical <a href=\"https://kilo.ai/docs/automate/agent-manager\">Agent Manager reference</a> and <a href=\"https://kilo.ai/docs/automate/agent-manager-workflows\">Agent Manager Workflows guide</a>. Prefer these links instead of guessing documentation paths.</p>\n<p>Agent Manager setup/run scripts are project files in the main repository's <code>.kilo/</code> directory. They are not <code>kilo.json</code> settings and should not be configured inside generated <code>.kilo/worktrees/&lt;name&gt;/</code> checkouts.</p>\n<p>Agent Manager worktrees usually live under <code>.kilo/worktrees/</code>. Think of each worktree as a separate checkout on its own branch: it enables parallel edits, but dependencies, build output, caches, databases, and generated files can consume significant disk space across many worktrees.</p>\n<h3>Worktree workflow and conflicts</h3>\n<p>To bring changes back, choose one path: Agent Manager Apply for selected changes, merge the worktree branch into the target branch, or create/update a PR from the worktree. Agent Manager has native PR support and shows PR status on worktrees.</p>\n<p>For conflict-heavy work, resolve inside the worktree before integration: merge or rebase the original/base branch into that worktree, ask the agent there to resolve conflicts and run checks, then apply, merge, or update the PR. Do not use <code>git stash</code> or autostash because stashes are shared across worktrees.</p>\n<p>Agent Manager does not fully orchestrate dependencies across worktrees; users usually choose and sequence worktrees themselves. For larger parallel efforts, suggest stabilizing shared contracts, schemas, interfaces, routes, file layout, or test shape on the original/base branch before creating separate worktrees.</p>\n<h3>Setup script</h3>\n<p>Setup scripts run once when a managed worktree is created, imported, or promoted, before the agent session starts. Use them for nested env files, local config, dependencies, databases, certificates, or other per-worktree setup.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr><th>Platform</th><th>Filenames checked in order</th></tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr><td>macOS / Linux</td><td><code>.kilo/setup-script</code>, <code>.kilo/setup-script.sh</code></td></tr>\n<tr><td>Windows</td><td><code>.kilo/setup-script.ps1</code>, <code>.kilo/setup-script.cmd</code>, <code>.kilo/setup-script.bat</code></td></tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>Behavior: runs from the worktree directory with <code>WORKTREE_PATH</code> set to the absolute worktree path and <code>REPO_PATH</code> set to the main repository root. Agent Manager copies root-level <code>.env</code> and <code>.env.*</code> files before setup without overwriting existing files; nested env files or other project-specific local files need setup script handling. Setup has a 5 minute timeout, and failures leave the worktree available for inspection.</p>\n<h3>Run script</h3>\n<p>Run scripts start or stop the user's project for the selected Agent Manager context. Use them for dev servers, watchers, emulators, queues, or other commands behind the Run button.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr><th>Platform</th><th>Filenames checked in order</th></tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr><td>macOS / Linux</td><td><code>.kilo/run-script</code>, <code>.kilo/run-script.sh</code></td></tr>\n<tr><td>Windows</td><td><code>.kilo/run-script.ps1</code>, <code>.kilo/run-script.cmd</code>, <code>.kilo/run-script.bat</code></td></tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>Behavior: runs from the selected worktree directory, or the main repo root when <code>LOCAL</code> is selected. Receives <code>WORKTREE_PATH</code> as the current run directory and <code>REPO_PATH</code> as the main repository root. If no valid run script exists, Run opens or creates the default script template instead of running. Run status is in memory only and is not persisted in <code>.kilo/agent-manager.json</code>.</p>\n<p>When the project supports it, avoid fixed global resources across worktrees by deriving ports, caches, Docker Compose project names, emulators, or databases from <code>WORKTREE_PATH</code> or the branch.</p>\n<h3>Troubleshooting scripts</h3>\n<ul>\n<li>If Run opens configuration instead of running, no valid run script exists for the current platform.</li>\n<li>If a script is ignored, verify the platform-specific filename from the tables above.</li>\n<li>For port conflicts (<code>EADDRINUSE</code>, browser/tests hitting the wrong worktree), inspect the app's dev-server config as well as <code>.kilo/run-script</code>. If fixing it requires application changes, ask whether the user wants the app made configurable or only wants a run-script workaround.</li>\n<li>If commands are missing, inspect how VS Code was launched. Run scripts load the user shell environment, but setup scripts only receive explicit <code>WORKTREE_PATH</code> and <code>REPO_PATH</code> from the task adapter, so <code>PATH</code> can differ.</li>\n<li>If setup times out, keep setup under 5 minutes or move long-running work into the run script or manual setup.</li>\n<li>If output is not visible in the Agent Manager chat terminal, explain that setup/run scripts write to VS Code task terminals. Ask the user for that output if it is needed for debugging.</li>\n<li>If unrelated conflicts appear, check for <code>git stash</code> usage. If stash caused it, suggest adding <code>AGENTS.md</code>, skill, or prompt guidance to avoid stash-based worktree merge flows.</li>\n</ul>\n<h3><code>agent-manager.json</code></h3>\n<p>Agent Manager persists UI, worktree, and session state in <code>.kilo/agent-manager.json</code>. Treat this file as diagnostic or recovery state for lost sessions, stale worktrees, missing UI state, or external worktree deletion/movement. It can be large, so inspect it selectively. It does not store script contents, run status, live tasks, or terminal mappings, and should not be edited to configure run/setup behavior.</p>\n<h2>Permissions</h2>\n<p>Scalar form applies to all patterns. Object form maps glob patterns to actions. Evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-jsonc\">{\n  &quot;permission&quot;: {\n    &quot;bash&quot;: &quot;allow&quot;, // scalar: allow all bash\n    &quot;edit&quot;: {\n      // object: pattern-matched\n      &quot;src/**&quot;: &quot;allow&quot;,\n      &quot;*.lock&quot;: &quot;deny&quot;,\n      &quot;*&quot;: &quot;ask&quot;, // fallback\n    },\n    &quot;read&quot;: &quot;ask&quot;,\n    &quot;skill&quot;: { &quot;my-skill&quot;: &quot;allow&quot; },\n    &quot;external_directory&quot;: &quot;deny&quot;,\n  },\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p>Actions: <code>&quot;allow&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;ask&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;deny&quot;</code>.
